headline: Average US 30-Year Mortgage Rate Falls to 7.18%, Marking Third Successive Decline
summary: The average US 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 7.18% from 7.24% in its third consecutive weekly decline, according to Freddie Mac.
why: Changes in long-term mortgage rates influence housing affordability and real estate sector purchasing activity.

impacts.name: US Housing
impacts.why: Lower mortgage rates marginally improve homebuyer purchasing power and loan affordability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
